title: Safety and compliance
blurb: E911, recording, retention clocks, attestation, abandon windows, and TCPA typing.
summary: Quote the document. Quote the clock. Do not invent a percent or a coverage map.

lessons.title: 911 is a location, not a prefix
objectives: Cite the data sheet and the EULA separately
paragraphs: The E911 data sheet says agents dial 911 directly, with no prefix, and that the service sends a dispatchable location. It names the United States and its territories, Kari's Law, and RAY BAUM'S Act. The partner named on that sheet is RedSky.

The end-user license also discusses emergency calling and names the United States or Canada. It says the call can fail if the address is wrong or unregistered, if power or internet is lost, if the service is suspended, during an outage, or with bad gear. The data sheet and the EULA do not draw the same map. Say which document you are quoting.
uncertain: The 2022 data sheet says US and territories. The EULA text this lab read also says US or Canada. Re-read both before you publish a coverage map.

lessons.title: The address has to be the room they are in
objectives: Use MyE911 history as the audit
paragraphs: A dispatchable location is the place responders can find a person. A headquarters address while the agent is at home is the failure the EULA describes. Remote and hybrid floors have to register the location the agent is actually using.

MyE911 call history, for an organization admin, shows time, user, number, location, recording, and the SIP invite. That is the audit after a test or a real call. It is not a substitute for registering the address first.

lessons.title: Recording is the customer's duty too
objectives: Assume hold and transfer can be recorded
paragraphs: The EULA treats recordings as customer data. It says calls can be recorded while the caller is on hold and after a transfer. It puts notice and consent on the customer, who has to follow the laws that apply to their calls.
This lab will not invent a script that 'covers every state.' Play the notice your counsel wrote. Put it in the IVR before the surprise, and do not assume hold music erases the recorder.

lessons.title: Retention is several clocks
objectives: Quote the clock for the object
paragraphs: The public retention page splits the clocks. VCC audio is the sooner of 30 days, a successful SFTP or FTP offload, or the contract. E911 recordings are 30 days. Agent data is 60 days. Campaign state is 120 days. A disabled domain is 120 days after closure. DIDs and toll-free numbers are 90 days after closure.
Quote the line that matches the object. 'We keep everything 30 days' is already wrong.

lessons.title: Attestation is not an ANI field
objectives: Keep ANI and attestation in separate sentences
Cite Certified Caller before you say signed
paragraphs: Certified Caller is Five9's published STIR/SHAKEN program, tied to FCC and CRTC expectations. A campaign profile that overrides ANI changes what you present. It does not, by itself, mean the call is attested.
Say 'we set local ANI' or 'we are in Certified Caller.' If you cannot point at the Certified Caller page for the second sentence, do not say it.

lessons.title: Abandon rate is a regulated posture
objectives: Keep the US 30-day and UK 24-hour windows straight
paragraphs: Default campaign settings call out a warning if you change Max Abandoned Call Percentage. Other fields on that page include Max Queue Time, Show Out of Numbers Alert, Monitor Abandoned Call Percentage, Call Analysis, Voice Detection level, and Action on Max Queue Time Expiration.

The measurement window is not a number you type for fun. The page describes a US rolling 30 days and a UK window of 24 hours, set with a Five9 representative. This lab does not invent the numeric default inside Max Abandoned Call Percentage. TCPA manual touch is a different control: type the number, no paste, Dial enables only on a match.
uncertain: This lab does not publish a numeric default for Max Abandoned Call Percentage. The defaults page describes the windows and the warning, not a percent we are willing to repeat.

lessons.title: TCPA manual touch is a physical control
objectives: Type external numbers in manual touch
Treat a grey Dial button as the control working
paragraphs: On domains where TCPA manual touch is enabled, other dialing modes are not available. Agents type the external number. Paste and drag are blocked. Dial enables only when the typed number matches. If preview times out, the agent goes Not Ready and nothing auto-dials.

The community article says this covers click-to-dial, previews, queue callbacks, and voicemail callbacks. Internal speed dial and a third-party transfer do not make you retype. The permission User Can Skip Contact Records in TCPA Manual Touch is how skipping is allowed. The pacing lab includes this drill so your hands learn the rule.
